conditions.introduction: predator-free continuation; existing world/rabbit state preserved; no relocation
conditions.fixed: saved population without respawn; configured juvenile burrow; no maternal grazing repulsion
conditions.stop: requested duration; continue ecology after predator extinction; existing accounting/allocation safety stops retained
